usedFor: Calendly holds booked meetings and Cloze holds your contacts, so “Create a Person” adds each invitee.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Create a Person” in Cloze
bestTemplate.why: Anyone who books any event type becomes a person in Cloze without anyone typing them in.

watchOut: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” is polling, so “Create a Project” runs after a scheduled check.
